requirements.reason: 引文缺失或未匹配，原判断保留在 raw_status；原题要求定位device-side assert的行与kernel。答案的四个主要路线均有官方证据支撑：(1) CUDA_LAUNCH_BLOCKING：NVIDIA Programming Guide 5.2.3.1（call_11dfd1e21b224d79bf538b8e.result）原文"This allows CUDA API errors to be observed at the exact API call that triggered them"；(2) PYTORCH_USE_CUDA_DSA：PyTorch官方源码（call_f743c20cb6744fa1ab01de2b.result）证实env_flag_set("PYTORCH_USE_CUDA_DSA")，且c10_retrieve_device_side_assertion_info输出"File containing assertion = ... self.filename << ':' << self.line_number"与"Name of kernel launched that led to failure = "，直接回答哪一行哪个kernel；compute capability≥6前提亦由dsa_check_if_all_devices_support_managed_memory中"if (dsa_get_device_compute_capability(i) < 6) return false"证实；(3) compute-sanitizer（call_7fe0ba0ed2c34baf9a92e1f0.result）证实kernel名/线程/块坐标报告能力及Hardware exception为Imprecise的限制，答案如实转述；(4) CUDA_DEVICE_WAITS_ON_EXCEPTION由Programming Guide 5.2.3.6证实。答案对未核实项（DSA引入版本、cuda-memcheck弃用）明确标注，未编造。次要辅助手段标注为社区做法未核实，不构成错误。
